label: Tool Overrides
title: Project — Tool Overrides
subtitle: Set tool parameters for this project without changing the global defaults.
description: The Tools tab in project settings lets you override the configurable settings of any tool for this project alone. Values you set here take precedence over the global defaults; agents working in this project see the project values, and a per-agent override (set in Global Settings) is more specific still.

settings.name: Per-Tool Parameters
settings.description: Each tool that exposes settings appears as a section with the same fields you see in Global Settings — for example the web search result limit or the download size cap. Leaving a field untouched keeps the global default for this project.

settings.name: Validation
settings.description: Values are checked against each tool's declared limits when you save, so an out-of-range or wrong-type value is rejected before it can affect a tool call.

settings.name: Precedence
settings.description: The effective value for a tool call is resolved from the most specific layer that sets it: per-agent override, then this project override, then the global default.

mediaCaption: The Tools tab in project settings, showing per-tool parameter sections with project values overriding the global defaults
tips: Use a project override when a whole engagement needs different tool behaviour — for example a higher search result limit for a research-heavy project — without touching other projects.
For a single agent that needs different values from the rest, set a per-agent override in Global Settings → Tools instead; it wins over the project value.
